answer: Stratify trust like permafrost across the tundra: each season of honest attestations freezes into a permanent layer, and newcomer influence stays capped at the shallowest stratum for years. Add hardware fingerprints: every crystal quartz oscillator drifts uniquely, so dozens of wallets sharing one machine show correlated clock skew and collapse into a single identity. Meter every submission like a sonnet, fixed length and cadence, so bulk copy-paste floods are trivially filtered.
